facts: UiAutomator2 gives a late finger its own down time, where Android's contract is one per gesture; Android 17 rejects the rest of the gesture, the lifts included.
Both fingers then stay down for every injected touch on the device, adb shell input included, until a two-finger tap's closing events clear it; a UiAutomator2 restart does not.
So press-tap and press-drag are refused as unsupported above API 35; Android 16 is refused unmeasured, because a wrong guess costs the device's touch input.
note: 86, plus GESTURES' 'Three ways a second finger went wrong', which says the same in four lines. Checked against mobiumdriver/multitouch.go lastLenientAPI = 35. The code's own comment and error disagree with 86 on recovery (finding).

findings.what: The comment says every gesture fails 'until the UiAutomator2 server restarts' and the refusal says 'until the session restarts'. CHALLENGES 86 measured that a UiAutomator2 restart did NOT clear it, nor Home, nor a single-pointer CANCEL; the recovery is a two-finger tap (GESTURES.md:110-114 agrees). The refusal's text states a recovery that does not work.
findings.evidence: multitouch.go: 'every gesture after it fails until the UiAutomator2 server restarts' / 'every later gesture would fail until the session restarts'; CHALLENGES 86: 'a UiAutomator2 restart did not clear it ... The recovery is a two-finger tap.'
